cases.surface: route-name resolution and exposed router fields
cases.source_probe: resolve route name `discovery` to the first well-known registration and assert the request exposes params plus the router, routerName, routerPath, _matchedRoute and _matchedRouteName fields.

cases.surface: secure/proxy detection for request.protocol and request.secure
cases.source_probe: request.protocol and request.secure follow trustProxy resolution for direct and proxied requests.

cases.surface: public capabilities and their contracts
cases.source_probe: assert the named exports, constructor/configuration schema, adapter persistence contract, provider events and cookie names/signing contracts.

cases.surface: delegation of migrated responsibilities to a Koa runtime
cases.source_probe: assert no migration-scope production module spawns, RPCs, dlopens or otherwise delegates request handling to a Koa runtime.

cases.surface: production imports of Koa in the migration scope
cases.source_probe: assert no migration-scope production module imports or calls Koa to serve a request.

cases.surface: CORS preflight OPTIONS responses
cases.source_probe: preflight OPTIONS carrying Access-Control-Request-Method to the listed endpoints returns 204 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin, Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Max-Age.

cases.surface: CORS response headers emitted per endpoint profile
cases.source_probe: assert the open, challenge, userinfo, client, clientWithDPoP and credential profiles emit Access-Control-Allow-Origin plus the profile-specific Access-Control-Expose-Headers.

cases.surface: request-body parsing for urlencoded and JSON bodies
cases.source_probe: assert application/x-www-form-urlencoded and application/json bodies yield the same ctx.oidc.body values.

cases.surface: session and interaction persistence timing
cases.source_probe: assert a touched session is upserted exactly once before the response and an untouched session is not persisted.

cases.surface: rejection of unsupported content types on body endpoints
cases.source_probe: assert a body endpoint receiving a present unsupported Content-Type keeps its `only <cty> content-type bodies are supported on <method> <path>` rejection.

cases.surface: HEAD routing to GET handlers
cases.source_probe: assert HEAD /jwks and HEAD /auth route to the GET handler and return the same status and headers with no body.

cases.surface: rejection of unparseable request bodies
cases.source_probe: assert an unparseable body yields 400 with error exactly `failed to parse the request body`.

cases.surface: mounting under a path prefix
cases.source_probe: assert provider.callback() serves correctly when mounted under the /oidc prefix through Express, Fastify and Hapi hosts.

cases.surface: response mode serialization for query, fragment, form_post, jwt and web_message
cases.source_probe: assert the query, fragment, form_post, jwt and web_message response modes keep their serialization and parameter placement.

cases.surface: request-body reading on body-consuming endpoints
cases.source_probe: assert the raw body bytes reach the token, introspection, revocation, registration, device, PAR, CIBA, credential, challenge and interaction readers.
